Ever wonder how your AC actually keeps you cool? Here's the simple version:

Your AC doesn't create cold air - it removes heat from inside your home and moves it outside. The evaporator coil absorbs heat, the compressor pumps refrigerant, and the condenser coil releases that heat outdoors. Pretty cool, right?

When any part of this process breaks down, you feel it fast. That's where we come in. Same day or don't pay! (813) 922-2209

AC not cooling? Before you panic, try these quick checks:

1. Check your thermostat - make sure it's set to COOL and the temperature is set below room temp
2. Check your filter - a clogged filter can restrict airflow
3. Check your outdoor unit - make sure it's not blocked by debris
4. Check your breaker - it may have tripped
